#Saisir des éléments distincts dans un tableau

from numpy import *

t = array([int] * 20)


def Saisie():
    b = False
    while not (b):
        n = int(input("Donner le nombre des cases: "))
        b = 5 <= n <= 20
    return n


def Remplir(n):
    t[0] = int(input(("t[0]=")))
    for i in range(1, n):
        b = False
        while not b:
            t[i] = int(input("t[" + str(i) + "] = "))
            b = not (existe(t, t[i], i - 1))


def existe(t, x, p):
    i = -1
    ok = False
    while not (ok) and i < p:
        i += 1
        ok = t[i] == x
    return ok


n = Saisie()
Remplir(n)
